svg.title: compress-nsa
svg.desc: NSA compression branch. Toy positions 0 to 159: windows of l = 32 tokens slide by d = 16, so neighbouring windows overlap by 16 and each emits one compressed key. At 64K this gives 4,095 compressed keys that are read densely and double as the block scorer; the raw KV is kept for the selection and window branches, so the cache does not shrink.
